earnings.title: Eaton Reports Record Third Quarter 2026 Results, with Strong Organic Growth, Accelerating Record Orders and Backlog; Raises Organic Growth Guidance
highlights: DUBLIN — November 3, 2026 — Intelligent power management company Eaton Corporation plc (NYSE:ETN) today reported strong third quarter 2026 results, including earnings per share of $2.77.

Adjusted earnings per share were a record of $3.68, excluding charges of $0.62 per share related to intangible amortization, $0.30 per share related to acquisitions and divestitures, and income of $0.01 per share related to a multi-year restructuring program.
Strong year-over-year total backlog growth of 46% in Electrical and 33% in Aerospace
Sales in the quarter were a record $8.9 billion, up 28% from the third quarter of 2025.
The sales increase consisted of 19% growth in organic sales, 8% growth from acquisitions, and 1% growth from foreign exchange.

quotes.text: Our strong third quarter performance reflects the focus and discipline our teams have demonstrated all year as we expand capacity, strengthen execution and position the business to meet accelerating customer demand.

outlook: Third quarter sales increased 28%, with organic sales growth of 19%, above the high end of guidance
Record segment margins of 25.3%, above the high end of guidance, with Electrical Americas margins improving 230 basis points sequentially
Full year 2026 earnings per share expected to be between $10.39 and $10.49; adjusted earnings per share expected to be between $13.70 and $13.80

Segment margins were a record 25.3%, 30 basis points above both the high end of the guidance range and the third quarter of 2025, driven by higher sales and improved performance amid continued capacity investments to support growth.

items.heading: We are subject to risks relating to acquisitions, joint ventures and investments, and risks relating to the integration of acquired companies.
Significant inflation or shortages of raw materials, energy, components, and/or labor, or similar challenges for our customers, could continue to adversely impact our results of operations.
Risks and uncertainties related to the development and use of artificial intelligence may present business, compliance and reputational risks.

If we are unable to protect our information technology infrastructure against service interruptions, data corruption, cyberbased attacks or network security breaches, product or service offerings could be compromised or operations could be disrupted or data confidentiality impaired.
Weather disruptions and regulatory, market and social reactions to them create uncertainties that could negatively impact our business.
Our ability to identify, attract, develop, engage, and retain qualified employees could affect our ability to execute our strategy.
